formulas.ascii: Cell c is in zone z when its zone ID is below zoneCapacity and not ignoredZone; it is valid when its calibrated value is finite and validity is nonzero. sums = valid values added in a fixed sorted tree (sumOrder sorted), means = sum / valueCount, minimums/maximums over valid cells; a zone with no valid cell gives sum 0 and NaN mean, minimum and maximum; cellCounts counts every in-zone cell. Uniform cell weights (projected grid).
